title: [305/07] Local OpenPlanner, generation and embedding providers
body:
Preserve local OpenPlanner event/vector/translation projections, scoped consumers, process serialization and bounded local generation/embedding. Distinguish execution evidence from acceptance of model output quality.

Tracks #338; decomposition epic #323; extracted from #305.

**Layer 7/23:** 45 changed files, +2328/−181. Review against previous layer #337; the diff contains only this task's paths.

This is a review/extraction of final file versions from PR #305, not a claim that its historical checkpoints or new intermediate heads are production-ready. All replacement PRs are draft. Their branches are cumulative and based on the source PR's historical merge-base; only layer 1 targets main. Some whole-file layers have forward dependencies, recorded below. Do not merge intermediate layers until their prerequisites and current-main reconciliation are validated.

Merge blockers: #324 (main reconciliation), #325 (qualification).

## Acceptance

- Two native writers yield eight events, eight vectors and sixteen accepted operations after reopening one shared ledger.
- Memory/search/translation reads preserve exact tenant/project scope and reject absent scope.
- Wrong embedding model, dimensions or vector count are rejected before persistence.
- Offline generation/embedding proof reports explicit model/cache prerequisites and does not hide unavailable operations.
- Inherited review findings for this scope are fixed with fresh evidence or explicitly adjudicated; the split itself resolves none.

## Original source validation

Fresh checks on the **cumulative source** `1d3b207a`: 35 targeted JavaScript checks passed; backend typecheck/server compile passed with zero compiler warnings; the full guarded CLJS test target passed 1,857 tests / 8,423 assertions, zero failures/errors. These results do not validate each intermediate PR, current-main integration, or a live server (the isolated OpenPlanner SDK link is absent). Frontend typecheck, production build and migration inventory passed; Vitest passed 274 tests with 41 TODO, and frontend CLJS passed 526 tests / 2,282 assertions with zero failures/errors/compiler warnings. Frontend lint passed with zero warnings/errors. **Strict backend lint fails: 188 warnings, zero errors, exit 2**; this remains a merge blocker. Live browser acceptance remains incomplete.

Commands for this scope, after prerequisites:

- `pnpm -C backend exec clojure -M:cljs scripts/compile-openplanner-process-proof.clj`
- `pnpm -C backend exec node scripts/verify-openplanner-admission.cjs`
- `pnpm -C backend run test`
- `pnpm -C backend run typecheck`
- `pnpm -C backend run lint`

## Dependencies

This cumulative layer references local namespaces introduced by later slices; it is a review partition and must not be merged as an independently passing unit:

- `knoxx.backend.extern.http-server` — supplied by `runtime-composition`
- `knoxx.backend.extern.session-guard` — supplied by `app-routes`
- `knoxx.backend.infra.clio-translation-evidence-store` — supplied by `translation-publication`
- `knoxx.backend.infra.clio-translation-split-store` — supplied by `translation-publication`
- `knoxx.backend.infra.persistence-bootstrap` — supplied by `runtime-composition`
- `knoxx.backend.infra.wiki-publication` — supplied by `translation-publication`
- `knoxx.backend.law.wiki-publication` — supplied by `translation-publication`

## Review focus

- The process verification runner is carried in another review slice; assemble it before running the check.
- Local model quality and full browser translation completion were not accepted in the handoff.
- A missing warmed model cache is a blocked prerequisite, not a pass.

## Inherited bot findings

- [Load the local provider before selecting it](https://github.com/open-hax/knoxx/pull/305#discussion_r3995778849) — revalidate; an unresolved historical thread does not establish a current defect.
- [Populate the local provider's documented configuration](https://github.com/open-hax/knoxx/pull/305#discussion_r3995778854) — revalidate; an unresolved historical thread does not establish a current defect.
- [Scope document metadata by project and garden](https://github.com/open-hax/knoxx/pull/305#discussion_r3995778861) — revalidate; an unresolved historical thread does not establish a current defect.

Preserved source commit: `1d3b207ab2e5bfc6b2fa149836b855d458a9c997`. The original extraction preserved its assigned source blobs. Verified review follow-ups and any ownership adjustments are recorded in the linked task.

<!-- pr305-current-validation -->

## Current review head

Head `ac6ece1ca001075a7f9b19cf79751a4d30e023db`. Earlier review fixes have been propagated through ordinary forward merges; no published history was rewritten. Review this scoped diff against its configured predecessor.

Preserve metadata-only document revisions and retry identity, scope translation metadata to the exact organization/project/garden relation, and return not-found for missing relations.

Validation on the assembled head `9672796cbd39c2264d490fd580fa5cd3a13f258b`: **1,879 backend tests / 8,639 assertions** and **529 frontend CLJS tests / 2,297 assertions**, zero failures/errors/compiler warnings. Backend server compile and frontend typecheck, complete production build, migration inventory and strict frontend lint pass. The 43 targeted JavaScript checks pass. Vitest's 274 passing tests / 41 TODO were run on the identical frontend tree (`343d94dd4760a814d5583ad4d600b80ace83ab28`); TODOs remain unexecuted.

**Strict backend lint remains blocked: 188 warnings, zero errors, exit 2.** This validates the assembled tree, not every intermediate head or a live deployment. The OpenPlanner runtime SDK link, current-main reconciliation (#324), live browser acceptance and remaining review findings (#325 and linked tasks) remain open. All PRs stay draft with auto-merge disabled.
